en: A monochrome postcard showing the ornate Glockenspiel (carillon clock) set into a steep tiled roof. Below the clock face are arched niches with figurative sculptures, and above them rises an open, decorative bell tower with a domed roof and balcony. In the background, other historic rooftops and a domed tower are visible. At the top of the postcard, printed text reads "Glockenspiel in Graz."
